verdict.rationale: Natural-language instruction is Mistral's core interface. Its docs describe agents that carry out tasks from natural-language requests using built-in tools: web search, code interpreter, document library, and image generation. Function calling, multi-agent handoffs and MCP extend this to external actions, and community users describe operating Le Chat conversationally. Missing for 10: evidence that platform administration (billing, limits, workspace and model management) can be driven by natural language, a first-party natural-language CLI or console assistant, and independent hands-on corroboration of agentic task execution.
